sentences.en: The newcomer sat down at the foot of the table.
sentences.zh: 新来的人坐在桌子的末端。

sentences.en: Isn't it nice when the newcomers are still so innocent?
sentences.zh: 当新人还这么天真无邪时，感觉真好，不是吗？

sentences.en: Acquaint a newcomer with the rules of the club.
sentences.zh: 向俱乐部的新成员介绍规则。

senses.zh: 新来的人,新手,新生事物
